description: This Java class `SourceMySqldiffFile` is a custom Liquibase task that executes a SQL file on a MySQL database. It handles copying the SQL file from the classpath to a temporary location, constructs the `mysql` command-line call, and executes it to source the SQL commands into the database. The class manages database connection properties, command execution, and error handling.

classes.name: SourceMySqldiffFile
classes.description: A custom Liquibase task class that executes a specified SQL file on a MySQL database by constructing and running a command-line MySQL process.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the work of copying the SQL file to a temporary location and executing it on the database using a command-line MySQL call.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the successful completion of the task.

methods.description: Setter for the SQL file path to be sourced.
